technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with strong trend structure create false reversal setup; price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and negative CMF indicate downtrend continuation despite stochastic bullish cross.

fundamental.summary: FE shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 42 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news sentiment limit conviction; neutral overall setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (405.28) with imminent FOMC event in 1 day, flat yield curve signalling recession risk, and utilities sector credit stress create severely adverse macro conditions despite 42-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI across all periods combined with stochastic bullish cross and ADX strength suggest capitulation-driven reversal potential, amplified by contrarian fear-zone opportunity (10/100 sentiment).
debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD, negative CMF distribution, and crisis-level VIX (405.28) + imminent FOMC event create structural downtrend continuation risk that overwhelms technical oversold signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme oversold RSI and stochastic bullish cross present contrarian setup, but price remains trapped below all major moving averages with bearish MACD and negative CMF indicating structural downtrend continuation rather than capitulation reversal.
decision.primary_risk: Crisis-level VIX (405.28) with imminent FOMC event in 1 day creates macro shock risk that can extend downtrend despite technical oversold conditions; utilities sector credit stress amplifies drawdown potential.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case dominance
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding 20 positions in Utilities sector with existing FE position; concentration risk and sector saturation reduce conviction further; skip entry and monitor for post-FOMC structural confirmation.
